create.name: Michael Mackintosh
create.bio:
Michael Mackintosh is a meditation teacher and spiritual life coach who has been teaching since 2004, when he began holding small meditation and coaching groups in Cambridge after several years of practice that took him repeatedly to India to live and study with yogis. In 2011 he moved to Hawaii to work on his teaching full time, and in 2014 he and his partner, Arielle Hecht, founded Awakened Academy, an online school that trains and certifies spiritual and holistic life coaches.

His teaching is built around dharma, the idea that each person has a particular path and contribution, and around practical steps for living it: meditation, soul-purpose inquiry, coaching skills, and building meaningful work. He mentors certification students one to one, takes on a small number of private mentoring clients, and wrote The Dharma Keys, a short book on finding one's path. His guided meditations, recorded since 2014 and many of them on Insight Timer, include practices for gratitude, letting go and soul consciousness, and he co-hosts the Spiritual Sense and Daily Meditation podcasts with the meditation teacher Shireen Chada. He lives on Kauai.

books.title: The Dharma Keys: Find Your Path with a Heart & Unlock Your True Calling in a World Gone Crazy
books.author: Michael Mackintosh
books.description: A short guide to dharma as a personal path, that asks the reader to look at their identity, their reason for being here and the work that is theirs to do. It moves from questioning inherited expectations to taking first steps towards work that suits your gifts.

courses.title: Spiritual Life Coach Certification
courses.description: Awakened Academy's original self-paced online certification, running since 2012. It covers inner practice, coaching craft, dharma and the business side of a coaching practice, with one-to-one mentoring from Michael.

courses.title: Holistic Life Coach Certification
courses.description: A self-paced online certification that trains coaches to work with the whole person, looking at how work, relationships, money and inner life affect one another. It is offered in tiers.

courses.title: Private Mentoring with Michael
courses.description: A season of one-to-one mentoring for people who want to act on a sense of calling, entered by a short written application that Michael reads himself.

free_resources.title: Michael Mackintosh on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His Insight Timer profile, with guided meditations recorded with Awakened Academy. The tracks are free to play.

free_resources.title: Discover Your Dharma
free_resources.description: A free short email course on finding the work you feel called to and the people you might serve, with the first lesson sent on sign-up.

free_resources.title: Spiritual Sense podcast
free_resources.description: A weekly conversation between Michael and Shireen Chada that takes one spiritual idea at a time and looks at how to use it in ordinary life. Free on Apple Podcasts and Spotify.
